newsitem.title: USA: Paging Network stake held by Calif group.
newsitem.headline: Paging Network stake held by Calif group.

text.p: A group led by Greenbrae, Calif.,-based West Highland Capital Inc said Monday it holds a 6.8 percent stake in Paging Network Inc or 7,012,800 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions were purchases between February 25 and April 24 at prices ranging from $6.0781 and $15.0938 per share.
The group said it holds the stake for investment purposes.
Paging Network, based in Plano, Texas, is a wireless messaging service.
